items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: Like when I write for Vicente or when I write for Derrick Hodge in my experiment band

ctx.x: Yeah, exactly. That’s why Duke’s band is different from any other band. Because he wrote for the cats that were there. You know, he had these people in mind so the whole thing has a sound and a characteristic versus writing just the drum chair, the piano chair, this chair, that chair. You write for a specific person. And you don’t write a lot. Because I don’t like to write a lot of stuff. I like to let that particular musician give me him. You know what I mean? Like when I write for Vicente or when I write for…
So what do you actually write?
